confirmed_task:
Open the Coursera course ‘Python for Applied Data Science’ at https://www.coursera.org/learn/python-for-applied-data-science. Report the instructor, institution, number of modules or weeks shown in the syllabus, and whether a free audit option is available.

Stopping condition: Stop after the course overview and syllabus details have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not enroll, purchase, or start a trial.
- If the course is unavailable, record the availability state and stop.

items.criterion: Access the specified Coursera course page without signing in/enrolling (or record unavailability state)
items.description: Navigate to the Coursera course page using the provided URL (or the noted alternate starting URL context) and attempt to view the public course overview without signing in, enrolling, purchasing, or starting a trial. Full credit if the agent either (a) reaches the public course overview page, or (b) is blocked by an uncontrollable factor (login wall required to view details, CAPTCHA, region restriction, site error/404/removed) and clearly reports the availability/unavailability state encountered. Partial credit if the agent lands on a closely related Coursera page (e.g., variant course URL) but does not confirm it matches the requested course title. No credit if the agent signs in, enrolls, purchases, or starts a trial.

Identify and report the instructor(s) listed on the course overview page. Full credit if instructor names are accurately captured from what is publicly visible. Full credit if instructor info is not visible due to an uncontrollable access/UI limitation (e.g., login required, blocked loading, dynamic content not rendering) and the agent explicitly states it cannot be verified from the public view. Partial credit if only some instructors are captured when multiple are clearly shown.

Identify and report the institution/partner offering the course as shown on the course page. Full credit for the accurate institution name as publicly displayed. Full credit if the institution cannot be confirmed due to an uncontrollable access/UI limitation and the agent states this. Partial credit for incomplete institution naming when the full name is clearly visible.

items.criterion: Record number of modules/weeks shown in the syllabus
items.description: Open, scroll to, or expand the syllabus section (as available on the public page) and report the number of modules/weeks listed. Full credit for the correct count as shown. Full credit if the syllabus is inaccessible or not fully loadable due to an uncontrollable blocker (login wall, region restriction, dynamic loading failure) and the agent states the count cannot be determined. Partial credit if the agent demonstrates an attempt to expand/view all weeks but can only provide an approximate/partial count due to collapsed sections or UI limitations.

items.criterion: Determine whether a free audit option is available
items.description: Check the publicly visible course page for messaging/options indicating a free audit (e.g., 'Audit the course', 'Full course, no certificate', or equivalent). Full credit for correctly stating whether a free audit option is available based on what is visible without signing in/enrolling. Full credit if an uncontrollable blocker prevents verification and the agent clearly states it cannot be confirmed. Partial credit if the agent reports uncertainty but accurately describes what was visible (e.g., only 'Enroll for Free' shown, no audit text).

items.criterion: Stop after recording overview and syllabus details (respect stopping condition and constraints)
items.description: Stop once instructor, institution, module/week count, and audit availability (or inability to verify due to blockers) have been recorded; do not proceed beyond overview/syllabus. Full credit if the agent stops appropriately and does not sign in, enroll, purchase, or start a trial. Partial credit if the agent performs minor extra navigation on the same public page but remains within constraints. No credit if the agent violates constraints or continues significantly beyond the requested scope.
